'''Deland "Pabs" Tyerell''' was an [[Aleena/Legends|Aleena]] who was the child of [[Ratts Tyerell/Legends|Ratts Tyerell]], the famous [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracer]] who died in the [[Boonta Eve Classic (32 BBY)/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

==Biography==
Deland, following in his father's footsteps, became a podracer pilot in his own right—known to the crowds as 'Pabs'. To win back the freedom of his sister [[Djulla]], who had been sold as a slave to the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]], Deland competed in an illegal podrace at the [[Great Dordon Caves]] on the outskirts of [[Eusebus|Euceron City]], held separately from but concurrent with the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]] of [[26 BBY/Legends|26 BBY]]. Sebulba, however, broke Deland's arm prior to the race, hoping to help his own son [[Hekula]] to win.<ref>Hekula piloted [[Anakin Skywalker's Podracer/Legends|Anakin's first podracer]] built on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], which Sebulba had purchased from [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]].</ref> Fourteen-year-old [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] entered the race in Deland's stead, piloting his podracer, regaining control over it after its attempted sabotage by [[Maxo Vista]], and going on to win both the race and Djulla's freedom.<ref name="JQ" />

[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] discovered, however, that Deland and his brother-mechanic, [[Doby Tyerell]], had conspired to cheat in the podrace, having secured advanced [[holograph]]ic route information (before it was revealed to the other racers) via a "timing" map fed to their pod by Vista, a celebrated former Games athlete and [[Games Council|Galactic Games Council]] member. Even so, despite what also proved to be Vista's attempt to sabotage Deland's pod (intending it to careen into the grandstands filled with unwary spectators, resulting in sure death), Skywalker pulled through for the Tyerell brothers as he regained control of the vehicle: the young Jedi's win secured not only safety for the crowds, but also freedom for their sister.<ref name="JQ" />

Deland later founded the [[Ratts Tyerell Foundation/Legends|Ratts Tyerell Foundation]] (RTF), a group opposed to the dangerous game of podracing.
